extDescription.message: Traces the route from your computer to the server of the page you are on, with the traceroute of your own system, and hands it to the page. The addresses of your own network are left out.

actionTitle.message: Trace the route back to this server

stateNoHost.message: The program librespeed-route is not installed, or the browser cannot start it.

installHint.message: Install it, then run: librespeed-route install-native-host

stateOldHost.message: The program librespeed-route is too old for this extension: update it.

stateNotHttps.message: Open the page of a server over https and click the icon there.

stateReady.message: Trace the route from this computer to $host$.

stateTracing.message: Tracing… this can take up to two minutes.

stateDone.message: Done. The route was handed to the page, without the addresses of your network.

stateNotDelivered.message: The page did not take it. Copy the line and paste it in the page.

errorRefused.message: This server cannot be traced (it is not a public address).

errorNoTool.message: No tracert, traceroute or tracepath was found on this computer.

errorSilent.message: No router answered: the network may be dropping the packets.

errorBusy.message: Wait a little: one trace at a time, and one in 30 seconds for each server.

errorTooLong.message: The route does not fit in the line for the page.

errorMoved.message: You left the page; nothing was handed over.

errorBadRequest.message: The extension and the program do not understand each other: update both.

siteOffText.message: Let the page of $host$ start a trace by itself, with its own button? It will only work after you click on that page, and only for this site.

siteOnText.message: The page of $host$ may start a trace with its own button, after you click on it.

siteDenied.message: The browser did not give the permission.

siteAllowed.message: The page of $host$ can now start a trace. You can turn it off here.

siteRevoked.message: Turned off for $host$. Its page can no longer start a trace.

copyManual.message: The browser did not copy it. The line is selected: press Ctrl+C (Cmd+C on a Mac) to copy it.

helpNoHost.message: The extension needs the separate program librespeed-route on this computer. Install it, run librespeed-route install-native-host, then open this popup again. Under Details you can see what the browser said.

helpOldTitle.message: The program is too old or too new

helpOld.message: The extension and the program must come from the same release. Update both, then open this popup again.

helpPage.message: A trace needs the page of a server over https. Pages of the browser itself (settings, new tab) and pages over http cannot be traced.

aboutDescription.message: Traces the route from your computer to the server of the page you are on, with the traceroute of your own system, and hands it to the page.

aboutHow.message: You press Trace. The extension asks the program on your computer to run the traceroute of your system to the server of this page. The result goes to the page as one line of text.

aboutPrivacy.message: The addresses of your own network are left out of the line. Nothing is sent anywhere except to the page you are on, and only the list of sites you allowed is kept.
